title: UX/UI Design Agency in Israel for SaaS, AI and Mobile Products
pillarHtml:
SPARK is a Tel Aviv product design and UX/UI agency helping SaaS, AI, mobile and complex software teams turn uncertain product ideas into usable, scalable experiences. We combine senior product strategy, user research, prototyping, interface design and implementation support.

Product design built around business and user risk

Strong UX/UI work starts before visual design. We clarify the product problem, identify the assumptions most likely to affect adoption, and decide what must be researched or tested before development becomes expensive. The result is a practical design process connected to business goals, user behavior and technical constraints.

Our engagements can support a focused feature, an MVP, a redesign of a complex platform, or the creation of a reusable design system. Every scope is shaped around the decisions the product team needs to make—not a fixed package of deliverables.

UX/UI services for SaaS, AI and mobile products

  • Product strategy and discovery: stakeholder alignment, value proposition, product definition and prioritization.
  • UX research: user interviews, workflow analysis, competitive research and usability evaluation.
  • Information architecture and UX design: complex flows, roles, permissions, navigation and edge cases.
  • Prototyping and validation: testable concepts that reduce uncertainty before engineering investment.
  • UI design and design systems: responsive interfaces, components, states, tokens and scalable patterns.
  • Developer handoff and design QA: behavior documentation, collaboration with engineering and implementation review.

Explore our complete product design and UX/UI services or review the dedicated software product design service.

How our product design process works

  1. Frame the challenge. We align on the product, users, constraints, evidence and definition of success.
  2. Research and map. We study users, workflows, alternatives and the product environment.
  3. Design and prototype. We make the important decisions visible and testable through flows and prototypes.
  4. Build the interface system. Approved behavior becomes a coherent UI and reusable component foundation.
  5. Support delivery. We work with product and engineering teams through handoff, QA and iteration.

The sequence changes when evidence supports a different approach. The purpose of the process is to lower risk and improve delivery, not to create unnecessary workshops.

Experience with complex digital products

Relevant UX/UI expertise is about product complexity, not only industry labels. SPARK's selected work includes professional SaaS platforms, AI-enabled products, healthcare technology, retail experiences and operational software. Our work for Evrideo, a cloud broadcasting platform, demonstrates experience organizing a specialized product for professional users. You can also review our broader product design portfolio.

Case studies should show more than polished screens. When evaluating any agency, look for evidence of the original problem, constraints, design reasoning, collaboration and what was delivered to the product team.

Why work with an Israel-based UX/UI agency?

A Tel Aviv product design partner can offer shared working hours, close collaboration with local stakeholders and familiarity with the pace of Israeli startup and enterprise teams. For products serving global markets, that local access should be paired with international product thinking, English-first delivery where required, and design decisions grounded in actual users.

SPARK works directly with founders, product leaders and engineering teams. Senior involvement continues throughout the engagement so strategic context is not lost between sales, discovery and delivery.

Choosing the right UX/UI agency in Israel

Compare agencies using the same criteria: relevant product complexity, senior team involvement, research and validation capability, implementation quality, case-study evidence, independent client feedback and commercial clarity. Our detailed guide explains how to choose a UX/UI design agency in Israel and includes practical questions for a shortlist.

Frequently asked questions

What types of companies does SPARK work with?

We work with startups, scale-ups and established organizations building SaaS, AI, mobile, web and complex operational products.

Can SPARK work with an existing product and design team?

Yes. We can lead a defined product-design initiative or work as a senior extension of an internal product, design and engineering team.

Does every project include user research?

We recommend the level of research needed for the specific risk. That may include interviews and usability testing, or a lighter evidence review when strong research already exists.

Can you create or improve a design system?

Yes. UI delivery can include reusable components, interaction states, responsive behavior and design-system foundations aligned with engineering needs.

Discuss your product

Tell us what you are building, where the product is currently stuck and what decision needs to be made next. Contact SPARK to discuss a focused UX/UI engagement.
